caption: the dave mirra spin-off that made the news - bmx tricking wrapped in early-2000s shock comedy.
about: Bmx xxx (2002) is the infamous z-axis bmx game: the dave mirra trick engine under a wall of early-2000s shock humor, live-action cutaways and the censorship saga that made headlines on three continents. The actual trick system is competent - the engine was proven - and the controversy is the historical document here.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
